test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She __finished her quickly breakfast__ and rushed to school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Finished her breakfast quickly"** accurately and grammatically places the adverb **"quickly"** to describe the manner in which she finished her breakfast.
 
• This option ensures that the subject** "She" **and the verb **"finished"** are correctly aligned, maintaining clear** subject-verb agreement.**
 
• It logically orders the sentence, making it easy to understand that she finished eating her breakfast in a quick manner.
 
• The structure adheres to standard English.
 
 
• **syntax: subject + verb + object + adverb.**
 
 
 
• Placing** "quickly"** after **"breakfast"** avoids **misplaced modifiers and ensures that "quickly" modifies how she finished her breakfast.**
 
• This construction provides a** natural, fluent reading experience, enhancing readability.**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Her breakfast finished quickly" **incorrectly suggests that the breakfast itself is performing the action of finishing.
 
• **"Quickly her breakfast finished" **is awkward and does not follow standard English syntax; it also implies the breakfast is finishing itself.
 
• **"Finished breakfast hers quickly"** is ungrammatical and incorrectly orders the possessive pronoun and breakfast.
